# GitHub repository setup

## About

**Description**
+Official CapSolver function tools for the OpenAI Agents SDK, with structured results and tracing-friendly execution.

**Website**
+https://docs.capsolver.com/en/guide/ai/capsolver-for-ai-agents/

**Topics**
+capsolver, openai, openai-agents, agents-sdk, ai-agents, captcha, function-calling, python, llm, agent-tools

**Suggested settings**

- Default branch: `main`
- Enable Issues and Discussions
- Enable secret scanning and Dependabot alerts
- Require CI before merging to `main`
- Enable squash merging and automatically delete merged branches
- Configure PyPI trusted publishing only after the package name is reserved

**Readiness:** `publish-now`
